System components such as GTK, the graphics driver and the Windows Universal C
Runtime are supplied by the operating-system or parent application installation;
no copies of those components are included in this portable UI package.
Their copyright notices, license texts and platform-specific information are
collected in system-libraries/, with its own README.txt and Linux component index.
